scripts.dev: pnpm infra:up && pnpm --filter @sila/contracts build && pnpm --filter @sila/api db:migrate && pnpm --parallel --filter @sila/contracts --filter @sila/api dev
scripts.infra:up: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.dev.yml --env-file .env up -d --wait postgres minio mailpit && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.dev.yml --env-file .env run --rm minio-init
scripts.start:e2e: pnpm infra:up && pnpm --filter @sila/contracts build && pnpm --filter @sila/api db:migrate && pnpm db:seed && pnpm --filter @sila/api build && AUTH_RATE_LIMIT=1000 pnpm --filter @sila/api start
